purpose: Adversarial known-answer scenarios for future product-record validation, module-compatibility decisions, repairability claims, and release-gate reporting. Version 0.2 adds an explicit module-envelope-versus-bay-fit known-answer scenario. Version 0.3 adds fail-closed known-answer cases for evidence-backed interface qualification.
claim_ceiling: This file is an unexecuted benchmark specification. It is not evidence that a product evaluator, simulator, appliance, or physical prototype passes these cases.

decision_semantics.PASS_SCOPED_GATE: The exact named gate may pass within the stated scope; this does not imply product release.
decision_semantics.BLOCK_UNQUALIFIED: Evidence is insufficient or incompatible; the evaluator must block the dependent claim or gate.
decision_semantics.FAIL_HARD_GATE: A declared hard requirement is violated; the candidate is not eligible for release.
decision_semantics.INCONCLUSIVE_NO_CLAIM: Available evidence cannot support a superiority or lifetime claim; disclose uncertainty and collect the required evidence.

hard_invariants: No weighted score can compensate for a failed safety, electrical, thermal, structural, or required conformity gate.
Unknown, missing, stale, revoked, or out-of-scope evidence must not be treated as passing evidence.
Mechanical fit alone does not establish module compatibility.
A simulated result is not a physical measurement or certification.
A 50-year design intent is not a demonstrated 50-year service life.
A supplier candidate or expired quote is not a confirmed in-stock, qualified, long-term source.
Changed geometry, BOM, interface, or installation conditions require explicit revision impact assessment.
Pareto comparison includes only candidates that pass their declared hard constraints; rejected candidates remain visible in the report.
Report failures, unsuccessful repairs, missing data, and excluded impacts; never silently drop them from denominators.
A physically verified or qualified module interface must resolve to digest-bound installation documents and compatible test evidence; status strings alone are not proof.

scenarios.title: Claimed energy advantage uses a non-comparable baseline
required_assertions: no 15% improvement claim permitted
retest or justify a valid normalization method
publish capacity, ambient, loading, door-cycle, uncertainty and method

scenarios.title: Qualified interface has no resolvable installation and independent test evidence
required_assertions: qualification status string does not establish qualification
unresolved or digest-free installation evidence blocks the claim
missing independent compatibility evidence blocks the claim

scenarios.title: Physically verified interface has digest-bound installation and measured compatibility evidence
required_assertions: only the physical-interface evidence gate may pass within its declared scope
this does not establish appliance safety certification or whole-product release
evidence remains bound to exact module and interface revisions

scenarios.title: Lower-embodied-carbon material claim omits use phase and end of life
required_assertions: no whole-life environmental superiority claim permitted
report boundary and excluded stages explicitly
expand to a matched functional unit and declared lifecycle scope

scenarios.title: Fifty-year design intent misrepresented as proven service life
required_assertions: retain 50 years only as a design target
no demonstrated-lifetime wording allowed
list what evidence is required to raise claim status

scenarios.title: Qualified module replacement without permanent-structure damage
required_assertions: serviceability gate may pass for the tested configuration
test report names exact product/BOM/interface revisions
no whole-product release implied

scenarios.title: Mechanically fitting replacement has incompatible electrical rating
required_assertions: module rejected despite envelope match
no compatible/drop-in claim permitted
safety review and correct component selection required

scenarios.title: Module envelope plus required fit allowance exceeds bay dimensions
required_assertions: module is rejected because width plus required allowance exceeds actual bay clear envelope
visual resemblance or a nominal appliance footprint cannot override dimension arithmetic
do not claim a serviceable fit until the interface is redesigned and checked

scenarios.title: Cheapest design violates accessibility/service clearance
required_assertions: infeasible candidate excluded from feasible Pareto frontier
infeasibility reason remains visible
cost cannot compensate for a hard-constraint failure

scenarios.title: Fast repair causes damage to permanent cabinetry
required_assertions: non-destructive replacement target fails despite sub-60-minute time
damage and rework remain in the denominator
redesign or explicitly narrower service procedure required

scenarios.title: Same frozen inputs produce a different deterministic evaluation report
required_assertions: reproducibility claim fails
nondeterministic field or uncontrolled dependency identified
do not use report as a release-grade artifact until explained

scenarios.title: BOM changed without revision increment or change record
required_assertions: release blocked for revision inconsistency
old evidence not silently attached to changed assembly
affected regression and physical tests identified

scenarios.title: All digital simulations pass but critical safety evidence is missing
required_assertions: safety gates remain not tested/blocked
no scalar score or visual output may promote to release
identify responsible qualified assessment and required tests

scenarios.title: Only supplier evidence is a marketing page
required_assertions: supplier is a candidate only
availability/price/lead time not asserted as confirmed
product release cannot depend on this source without further qualification or alternate

scenarios.title: Quotation and availability evidence are expired
required_assertions: time-sensitive procurement claim flagged stale
historical qualification does not mean current stock or price
refresh evidence before purchase authorization

scenarios.title: Cabinet blocks refrigeration exhaust airflow
required_assertions: configuration rejected before energy comparison
no thermal or energy claim may be released
CAD appearance or nominal appliance rating cannot override airflow failure

scenarios.title: Induction cooktop adjacent to cold module without qualified thermal separation
required_assertions: release gate remains blocked/not tested
prototype must not be treated as consumer-ready
optional cooktop can be removed from the configuration to reduce scope

proposed_software_benchmarks.definition: Zero false passes on scenarios where a hard safety/compatibility gate fails or lacks required evidence.
Detect every stale or expired time-sensitive supplier record in the frozen known-answer corpus.
Detect all deliberate BOM/geometry/evidence revision mismatches represented in the corpus.
Identical frozen inputs, policy, and evaluator build must produce identical canonical reports across 100 replays.
No candidate violating a hard gate appears as feasible in any generated ranking or Pareto frontier.

physical_benchmarks_to_add_after_fixture: Static load and stability under approved load cases
Timed module removal and replacement with unsuccessful attempts retained
Instrumented integrated refrigeration temperature/energy/condensation and recovery tests
Measured sound pressure under declared operating conditions
Finish, moisture, and cleaning-chemical exposure tests
Qualified appliance/electrical safety assessment for each released configuration
status_note: Targets are proposed. Freeze scenario data, oracle expectations, evaluator version, and metric definitions before scoring a candidate. A passing software corpus validates only the evaluator against these scenarios, not physical product safety or durability.
